jobs.occupation: Warehouse Position in the Inbound Department at Imerco

• 
Receiving incoming shipments

• 
Opening, lifting, and moving boxes

• 
Unloading pallets

• 
Working with the Autostore

• 
Valuable experience from working during the busy Christmas season

• 
A friendly and supportive team atmosphere

• 
Clear tasks and structured workflows

• 
Convenient location with public transport and free parking

• 
Have experince working in a Warehouse - it's an advantage to have worked with an autostore before

• 
Prefer hands-on, structured work

• 
Be physically able to stay on your feet most of the day

Communicate well in either English or Danish

Køkkenet står for den daglige restaurantdrift samt selskaber og arrangementer, og der er derfor fokus på kvalitet, effektivitet og godt samarbejde i køkkenet.

Sikre overholdelse af hygiejne- og fødevaresikkerhedsregler

Bidrage til en effektiv drift under både almindelig service og selskaber

Vi søger dig, der

• 
Har relevant erfaring fra et professionelt køkken

• 
Har erfaring som souschef, køkkenansvarlig, teamleder eller tilsvarende

• 
Har erfaring med koordinering eller ledelse af køkkenpersonale

Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for køkkendriften

Able to remain calm during busy services

Opportunities for professional and personal development

Salary based on experience and qualifications

Employment on ordinary Danish terms

jobs.occupation: Experienced Welder / Tack Welder for Weekend Day Shift
jobs.description:
Do you have solid experience in welding and tack welding, and do you thrive in a structured environment with clear expectations and a strong focus on quality and precision? At Give Steel A/S, you will become an important part of our weekend day shift production team, where your contribution helps ensure strong, documented steel structures.

Why Choose Us?

You will become part of a manufacturing engineering and steel construction company with a strong focus on quality, safety, and responsible production. We are committed to employee development and offer a workplace with freedom under responsibility, well-organised working conditions, and opportunities for professional growth.

You will be employed under the Danish Collective Agreement for the Industry Sector (Industriens Overenskomst). In addition, we offer private health insurance and the option to join our canteen scheme.

What Will Your Workday Look Like?

You will join a team manufacturing load-bearing steel structures and steel trusses. The work is carried out on the weekend day shift, where you will follow established work procedures and contribute to ensuring tasks are completed safely, efficiently, and to a high standard of quality.

Your working hours will be from 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Tack welding and welding steel structures based on technical drawings and work instructions

• Preparing components and checking measurements, fit, and quality

• Carrying out tasks with a systematic and thorough approach

• Contributing to strong teamwork with colleagues in production

• Complying with all applicable safety, quality, and documentation requirements

What Are We Looking For?

We are looking for an experienced and reliable employee who works in a structured and detail-oriented manner. You thrive in a well-defined environment, can maintain an overview in a busy production setting, and take pride in delivering lasting, high-quality results.

We expect that you:

• Have solid experience as a welder and/or tack welder

• Work thoroughly, responsibly, and with a strong focus on quality

• Can read and understand technical drawings

• Are reliable and a team player

• Contribute positively to a professional and safe working environment

• Speak Danish and/or English

• Live in Denmark within a reasonable commuting distance of Brande

We can provide certification in various welding methods, so it is not important whether you already hold welding certificates.

Interested?

If you have any questions about the position, please contact our Head of Production, Tomas Slepavicius, at tsl@givesteel.com.

We would like to receive your CV, clearly outlining your relevant experience. We are looking for someone who can start as soon as possible, and we will remove the job advertisement once the position has been filled.

About Give Steel A/S

Give Steel A/S is a manufacturing engineering and steel construction company that develops, designs, manufactures, and erects load-bearing steel structures and steel trusses. Quality, safety, and documentation are an integral part of our daily operations, while we also maintain a strong focus on CO₂ reduction and responsible production.

You will become part of an international company with strong technical expertise and opportunities for professional development. Collaboration, responsibility, and integrity are key values in our daily work.

• Restaurant management experience – you know how to run a smooth, profitable operation.
• Hands-on service background
• A background in music or cultural studies – formal education or significant practical experience in music, arts, or event curation is a strong plus.
• Excellent language skills – fluent in English and Chinese (to communicate with our team, including chefs and staff). Danish is a big advantage, as it helps with local suppliers and daily interactions. Your ResponsibilitiesAs our Restaurant Manager, you will be the driving force behind our new concept. Your key tasks will include:
• Designing and implementing the music-restaurant concept – curating playlists, planning live or DJ events, and aligning the audio experience with our brand.
• Creating staff rotas – ensuring optimal coverage while respecting work-life balance.
• Leading service-quality training – coaching the team to deliver warm, professional, and consistent service.
• Working closely with the kitchen team – ensuring seamless coordination between front-of-house and back-of-house for a flawless end-to-end guest journey.
• Overseeing daily operations – from opening procedures to guest relations, inventory, and health & safety standards.We offer:

jobs.description: Job Description: Airbus Commercial Aircraft is looking for an Engineer in Certification and airworthiness (f/m) to join our Design and Repair certification department based in Toulouse, France.You will be part of a team providing airworthiness approval to In-Service repair solutions . As part of the Certification team , you will be involved with Customer Care Center matters to give the best repair solution to the customers for them to bring back their aircraft in an airworthy condition after an event. Your working environment:Global capital of aeronautics and European capital for space research, Toulouse is a dynamic city in the southwest of France served by an international airport. Ideally located between the Mediterranean sea and the Atlantic ocean and close to the Pyrenees mountains, it offers plenty of options for outdoor activities! How we care for you:Financial rewards: Attractive salary, agreements on success and profit sharing schemes, employee savings plan abounded by Airbus and employee stock purchase plan on a voluntary basis. Work / Life Balance:   Extra days-off for special occasions, holiday transfer option, a Staff council offering many social, cultural and sport activities and other services. Wellbeing / Health: Complementary health insurance coverage (disability, invalidity, death). Depending on the site: health services center, concierge services, gym, carpooling application. Individual development: Great upskilling opportunities and development prospects  with unlimited access to +10.000 e-learning courses to develop your employability, certifications, expert career path, accelerated development programmes, national and international mobility. At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly.     Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking. Your challenges:We are in close collaboration with all Airbus design offices worldwide.  We are working together with two other off-shore teams, in a follow the sun approach :  one based in Mobile (USA)  one based in Bangalore (India) The work will be performed 7 days a week (monday to sunday) in shifts on day time hours by rotation.  Your main tasks and responsibilities are: Provide Airworthiness approval of in-service repair solutions supported by the Repair and Design Approval Form (RDAF), and Flight Condition Documents (FCD).   Interface with Airbus customer services, design offices, chief engineer teams and the other airworthiness departments.   Act on request as airworthiness specialists in a multifunctional team to solve Aircraft on Ground situations (AOG).  This position is an opportunity to work for all Airbus civil programs, on all ATA chapters and develop multi-skills.  Being part of a very dynamic team, you will acquire a high level of overall aircraft knowledge, and enlarge your network within the company. After the initial training period, the work will be performed seven days a week (Monday to Sunday) in shifts on daytime hours by rotation. Your boarding pass:You have an advanced level in English.  You are educated to degree level (or equivalent) in Engineering or a related discipline. You have structure and systems skills.  You have a good general knowledge in aeronautics.  You have experience in the design office and/or in airworthiness. Knowledge in configuration management is a plus.  You are a real collaborative team player, reactive and curious. This position requires a security clearance or will require being eligible for clearance by the recognized authorities.  Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.  Take your career to a new level and apply online now! -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------Airbus Commercial Aircraft recherche un Ingénieur en certification et navigabilité   (f/h) pour rejoindre notre Service de certification des réparations basé à Toulouse, France . Vous ferez partie d'une équipe qui approuve les solutions de réparations proposées par le bureau d'études du Service Client, suite à un événement en service . Au sein de l'équipe certification et navigabilité, vous aurez la responsabilité de vérifier et attester que la solution technique ainsi appliquée restaure la navigabilité de l'avion. Cette étape est indispensable pour la remise en service de l'avion. Votre environnement de travail :Capitale mondiale de l'aéronautique et capitale européenne de la recherche dans le spatial, Toulouse est une ville dynamique du sud-ouest de la France desservie par un aéroport international. Idéalement située entre la mer Méditerranée et l'océan Atlantique et à proximité des Pyrénées, elle offre de nombreuses possibilités d'activités de plein air !
